name: WorkBuddy
short: Tencent's everyday office-work AI agent for Mac and Windows — describe a task in one sentence and get finished reports, decks and spreadsheets from your own files. Provides Tencent Hy4 on Free, Pro and Team subscriptions with a shared credit pool.

plans.notes: Shared credit pool and admin console; $480/seat/year.
